title: How to Improve Dull Skin Naturally: Simple Habits That Help
ex: Practical ways to improve dull skin naturally in India: sleep, food, gentle cleansing, weekly exfoliation, sunscreen, safe kitchen masks, and when to see a doctor.
rt: How to Improve Dull Skin Naturally: Simple Habits | Mirc Glow
rd: How to improve dull skin naturally: sleep, gentle cleansing after the commute, weekly exfoliation, sunscreen, safe kitchen masks, and what to avoid.
keyword: how to improve dull skin naturally
quick: Start with the basics: sleep well, wash off dust and sunscreen gently at night, exfoliate once a week, moisturise, and wear sunscreen every morning. Curd or honey masks are fine after a patch test; skip lemon, baking soda and toothpaste. See a doctor if dullness comes with constant tiredness.
facts: Most dull skin is dehydrated, tired or covered in dust, not a skin colour issue.
Exfoliate gently once a week; over-scrubbing makes skin look duller.
Lemon, baking soda and toothpaste can irritate facial skin.
Dullness with constant tiredness can be worth a doctor's check.
